exposure: intravascular cooling with extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO)
outcome: developmental quotient (DQ) >= 70 (measured by Kyoto Scale of Psychological Development)
cohort: Neonates with moderate to severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), a 10 min Apgar score ≤ 3 or umbilical artery pH ≤ 6.7, persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn, and an oxygenation index of ≥ 25 to < 40.
finding: Intravascular cooling with ECMO resulted in a significantly higher proportion (70.6%) of neonates achieving a developmental quotient ≥ 70 compared to conventional TH (33.3%).
